ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Mars

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between relationships and family. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between routine and conversations. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between romance and money. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between family and your image. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between money and friendships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your image and your career. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your career and relationships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The square between the Sun and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.
